scripts.build: cd .. && uv run --locked --no-sync python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_docs_generate_api.py && uv run --locked --no-sync python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_docs_tutorial.py && uv run --locked --script scripts/generate_api.py && cd docs && astro build && cd .. && uv run --locked --no-sync python scripts/generate_api.py --redirects && uv run --locked --no-sync python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_docs_legacy_fragments.py
scripts.dev: cd .. && uv run --locked --script scripts/generate_api.py && cd docs && astro dev
